name: Kamila Andini
bio: Kamila Andini is an Indonesian film director known for her critically acclaimed debut The Mirror Never Lies. She is the daughter of noted Indonesian film director Garin Nugroho and wife of fellow director Ifa Isfansyah.

credits.title: Jilah and the Man with Two Names
credits.overview: After exchanging hundreds of nude pictures, a woman’s virtual date suddenly disappears. After a period of time, she eventually meets him in person, but he is not the man she dated virtually. It turns out she had been catfished by a 21-year-old construction worker.

credits.title: Casparina
credits.overview: This film is based on the story of Francisca Casparina Fanggidaej, a journalist, activist, and member of the House of Representatives during the Soekarno era who lived in exile after 1965.

credits.title: Four Seasons in Java
credits.overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. credits.title: The Architecture of Love
credits.overview: Raia, a famous writer struggling with writer's block, travels to New York to get inspired. There, she meets River and becomes entangled in a love story haunted by the past.

credits.title: Devil's Horns
credits.overview: Birth and death occur when the devil's horns rise. The terror of waiting for the birth of a child from a pre-pregnant marriage and the 14 day wait for death due to an implant that had not been removed.

credits.title: Before, Now & Then
credits.overview: Set against Indonesia’s turbulent post-independence years in the 1960s, the story revolves around the domestic life of a woman whose personal life has been completely overturned by the political turmoil.

credits.title: Terikat
credits.overview: A dance film that explores the role of women in the domestic space.

credits.title: Along the Road
credits.overview: A story of childhood memories, love, and family.  A story where Honda plays a part in every twist and turn as a family journeys through life, where childhood friends find true love only to find that fate seems to have other plans...

credits.title: Yuni
credits.overview: In her last year of secondary school, a bright Indonesian student is determined to pursue her education and resist getting married, despite the expectations of her community.

credits.title: Anugerah Terindah
credits.overview: Based on songs popularized by Sheila on 7, this musical tells the tale of how friendship & love could become the greatest gift anyone can ask for.

credits.title: Angel Sign
credits.overview: Manga creator Tsukasa Hojo's debut live-action film. 'Angel Sign' is Hojo's debut as a director, which is made by editing a number of short films into one movie. Hojo directs the "Prologue" and "Epilogue" stories, while a different director will handle each of the other stories, which were selected in Silent Manga Audi

credits.title: Sekar
credits.overview: Sekar is a blind woman who makes her mother's batik her whole world. Until Sekar met a silversmith who made batik motifs for her. The man brought batik to life in another way.

credits.title: The Seen and Unseen
credits.overview: Tantra and Tantri are inseparable. When they secretly steal eggs from the family’s sacrificial offering, Tantri always gets the whites and Tantra the yolks. credits.overview: A mother tries to leave her memory of being a victim during the war in Timor Leste. A daughter tries to secure herself under a marriage. credits.title: Following Diana
credits.overview: When Diana’s husband returns home one night with big news—he has taken on a second wife, and expects Diana to live in harmony with the situation—she does what is least expected and plans to make a life on her terms.

credits.title: The Mirror Never Lies
